blocker.message: The retirement VCs lost the old semaphore manager ID uniqueness across IdRemoveObj. Its postcondition only gives contains(old,id,idnode_2) and store_idmanager(remove(old,id)); remove filters all matching IDs, so post-wf does not recover old NoDup. A pre-VC model with two distinct semaphore objects carrying the deleted ID can return the other object ID node, leaving no ownership of the target sem ID field required by SemaphoreRetired. Preserve a pure old-manager NoDup/unique-node fact derived before the call, through deletion and retirement.
